subject: BCP witness plan and RTO/RPO telemetry for HarborCore
messages:
From: Claudia Mendes <claudia@harborcore.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Live witness window + RPO/RTO telemetry samples

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for walking through the SIG/CAIQ responses last week. As part of HarborCore's SOC 2 readiness review the internal audit team wants a short live witness of Redwood's DR warm-start and some supporting telemetry for RTO/RPO claims. Specific asks: 

- A 60-90 minute live witness during which ops triggers a controlled failover for a single region and demonstrates KV-cache warmstart and request-response timings.
- Export of representative RPO sampling (token-level timelines, store-to-restore timestamps) for the week of Nov 15-21, 2026.
- A short narrative of the expected RTO/RPO for the dedicated-host and private deployments, and the fallback policy between model variants.

Can you confirm what telemetry you can provide and a couple of candidate dates for the live witness? TrustLab (our external SOC advisor) will join.

Appreciate quick confirmation — Claudia

Claudia Mendes
Head of Security
HarborCore Capital
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Claudia Mendes <claudia@harborcore.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Live witness window + RPO/RTO telemetry samples

Claudia — thanks for the clear list. We can do this and I sketched an ops-first plan below. High level: 60-minute witness (30-min demo + 30-min Q&A) + telemetry packet.

Planned deliverables:
- Live witness script (attached) and an .ics invite for the runbook window (witness-invite.ics).
- RPO sampling CSV with store/restore timestamps aggregated by service component (rpo-sample-logs.csv).
- KV cache warmstart trace and timing excerpt (kv-cache-warmstart-trace.txt).
- Narrative: short one-page RTO/RPO commitments for Hosted/Dedicated/Private.

Candidate windows (PST):
- Thu Dec 10, 2026 09:00-10:30
- Fri Dec 11, 2026 13:00-14:30
- Mon Dec 14, 2026 08:30-10:00

Two quick clarifications before we lock time: 
1) Do you want the witness performed against our Dedicated pool for HarborCore or the Private (VPC) bring-up? Dedicated is easiest to orchestrate; Private requires your network team on the call.
2) TrustLab: will they need raw syscall-level traces or are token-level timelines sufficient for the SOC narrative?

Next steps: If Thu works I’ll loop in Ops and Kim will attach the telemetry excerpt.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Claudia Mendes <claudia@harborcore.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Live witness window + RPO/RTO telemetry samples

Adding technical detail for the packet and witness: 

- RPO export: we will provide a CSV with the following columns: component, event_type (persist, snapshot, restore_start, restore_complete), timestamp_iso, token_count, approximate_gap_seconds. The attached rpo-sample-logs.csv is a redacted sample.
- KV warmstart trace: excerpt includes cold-start vs warm-start latencies for the last 50 prefix loads; we will annotate the trace where the KV cache is primed.
- RTO narrative: we’ll include expected medians and 95th percentile across sequence lengths (16, 128, 1024 tokens) for Dedicated and Private. For Hosted we will explain routing/fallback behavior and the automatic model-variant downgrade policy that preserves availability.

Operational notes for the live run: 
- Controlled failover steps: mark node as unready, route traffic to standby, warm up KV cache on standby, validate in-flight sessions.
- We’ll run synthetic traffic generator (demo-only) to show latency and success rate during warmstart.

I attached the two sample files. If we go Thu Dec 10 09:00 PST I'll book Ops and an on-call engineer.

Kimberly Park
Senior Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Claudia Mendes <claudia@harborcore.com>, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Live witness window + RPO/RTO telemetry samples

Claudia — Thu Dec 10 09:00-10:30 PST is confirmed on our side. I’ve sent the calendar invite (witness-invite.ics) and shared a short read-ahead doc on the witness flow (link included). TrustLab, please let us know if you need additional artifact types ahead of time.

Quick logistics: please provide a single Zoom contact and the email for HarborCore network ops if you prefer Private environment testing. Otherwise we’ll perform the demonstration on Dedicated and annotate how the steps differ for Private.

See you Thursday — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
